title: Remove stale --no-daemon flag references across repo
description: The --no-daemon flag was removed from bd in v0.51.0 (Feb 2026). Our installed bd is v1.0.2, which rejects the flag with 'unknown flag'. The flag is referenced in 15+ files including CLAUDE.md hard rules, skills, scripts, package.json alias, plans, and specs. Worktree safety in modern bd is automatic via git common-directory discovery (confirmed by 'bd worktree --help'). Action: strip --no-daemon everywhere, replace the rule wording in CLAUDE.md files, drop the broken bun alias, initialize beads with prefix 'ucs'.
close_reason: Stripped --no-daemon from all 15 files (rule, examples, scripts, alias, plans, specs). Updated rule wording in CLAUDE.md (project + global), README, and beads/using-this-repo skills to explain modern worktree-safety. Initialized beads with prefix 'ucs' in both DB and config.yaml (so fresh clones pick it up). Verified: bd ready, bd list, scripts/bd-recipes.sh ready all work.

title: Implement /api/chat SvelteKit endpoint
description:
## Acceptance criteria
- `packages/schemas/src/chat.ts` exports `chatRequestSchema = z.strictObject({ messages: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), role: z.enum(['system', 'user', 'assistant']), parts: z.array(z.unknown()) })) })` and the inferred `ChatRequest` type.
- `packages/schemas/src/index.ts` re-exports the chat schemas alongside the existing `message` and `qa-case` exports.
- `apps/web/src/routes/api/chat/+server.ts` exports a `POST` `RequestHandler` that:
  - Returns 400 with a JSON `error` body on malformed JSON or Zod failure.
  - Returns 500 with `{ error: "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not set" }` when the env var is missing.
  - Otherwise calls `streamChat(parsed.data.messages as UIMessage[])` and returns `result.toUIMessageStreamResponse()`.
- `apps/web/tests/chat-route.test.ts` covers all three branches (400, 500, 200) with `@url-cheat-sheet/agent`'s `streamChat` mocked via `vi.mock`. Passes 3/3.
- `bun run --filter @url-cheat-sheet/web test` green; `bun run --filter @url-cheat-sheet/web check` clean.

## Coordination note
Schema addition is small and stays in this issue (chatRequestSchema is endpoint-scoped). If a future schema-team policy moves it out, file a follow-up — do not block this issue on that decision.

## Affected files
- `packages/schemas/src/chat.ts` (create)
- `packages/schemas/src/index.ts` (modify)
- `apps/web/src/routes/api/chat/+server.ts` (create)
- `apps/web/tests/chat-route.test.ts` (create)

title: Implement streamChat agent with system prompt
description:

title: Implement grep_rfc tool with tests
description:
## Acceptance criteria
- `packages/agent/src/tools/grep-rfc.ts` exports:
  - `grepLines(text: string, pattern: string): GrepMatch[]` — pure helper, no SDK dependency. Case-insensitive literal substring; 1-based line numbers; up to 2 lines of `before`/`after` context (clamped at document edges); capped at 20 matches.
  - `grepRfc` — AI SDK `tool()` with `inputSchema: z.strictObject({ pattern: z.string() })`, bound to the bundled RFC text via `?raw` import.
  - `GrepMatch` type.
- `packages/agent/tests/grep-rfc.test.ts` covers: literal hit + 1-based line numbers, case insensitivity, 2-line context, start-of-doc clamp, end-of-doc clamp, no-match returns `[]`, 20-match cap. Passes 7/7.
- `bun run --filter @url-cheat-sheet/agent build` clean (tsc -b succeeds).
